description: This Java source file defines a `LogFragment` class that extends Android's `Fragment`. It provides a user interface component containing a `LogView` within a `ScrollView`, used for displaying log data in an Android app. The class manages the creation and layout of its views, sets text appearance and padding, and includes a text watcher to scroll to the bottom when new log entries are added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays a log view within a scroll view, facilitating log output in an app.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView containing the LogView, setting layout parameters, padding, typeface, gravity, and text style.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy by calling inflateViews(), adds a TextWatcher to auto scroll on new log entries, and returns the main view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides access to the LogView instance for external use.
